title: The Last Detention
premise: Astrid Quintana, seventeen and de facto parent to her two younger siblings, is barely holding their household together when a group chat of strangers starts texting her predictions that come true — and reveals the school board covered up a toxic mold scandal that sickened students, including her little brother. As the chat's anonymous members pull her into an underground network of students and janitors gathering evidence outside legal channels, Astrid must choose between protecting her family's fragile stability and burning down the institution that betrayed them. The story ends at prom night, where Astrid detonates the evidence publicly, the board resigns, and her ragtag found family becomes the real one she can rely on.
about_author: Vesper Brightwater is the pen name of a former night-shift barista who wrote this novel in the margins of receipts while raising younger siblings of her own. She writes stories about kids who hold families together and then learn to be held.

chapters.title: Fine Is a Full-Time Job
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. We meet the Quintana household: cold cereal dinners, mom's night shifts, Astrid forging permission slips like a pro. Her brother Mateo's chronic cough is dismissed as allergies. Then a group chat called 'the last detention' adds her with a message predicting tomorrow's fire drill — before it happens. Emotional beat: exhausted competence cracking into unease; she replies 'wrong number' but doesn't leave the chat.

chapters.title: Predictions Come With Receipts
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, with interludes from chat member Dev, a custodian's kid. The chat predicts a pipe burst in the east wing — accurate again — then sends a photo of 2019 board minutes redacting something called 'Remediation Contract 7.' Mateo's cough matches the pattern of classrooms on that wing. Astrid starts sneaking into the records room. Emotional beat: denial curdling into purpose as the danger becomes personal.

chapters.title: What the Board Buried
chapters.summary: Alternating Astrid and Dev POVs. The crew — Astrid, Dev, archivist nerd Priya, and scared whistleblower Mr. Okafor — assemble proof the board knew about black mold for three years and paid to silence families. But the board gets tipped off; Okafor is fired, and Astrid's mom is threatened with job loss if Astrid keeps digging. Prom is Friday. Emotional beat: terror and resolve fused — they have one shot, and it has to be loud.

chapters.title: The Last Detention
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. During prom, the crew hijacks the gym AV system to broadcast the documents, testimony, and Mateo's medical file to every phone in the building. Chaos, then silence, then students chanting. The board resigns within weeks; remediation begins; Okafor is reinstated. Astrid finally sleeps a full night while her siblings make breakfast. Emotional beat: catharsis — justice seized, and a girl who was 'fine' learning she no longer has to be fine alone.
